values: Counterexamples to Satoh's SL(2) representation-filtration conjecture. Satoh, OWR 2018, pp. 88-89; catalogue 30003703 / OWR-15987-013. Explicit counterexamples refute the original 2018 equality for the rational SL(2) matrix-entry component algebra: D_n(5) != A_n(5) for every n >= 4 and D_n(6) != A_n(6) for every n >= 3. A uses the integral free-group lower central series; D acts on the whole J quotient. Classical Burde/Razmyslov identity credit; no new PI identity or general PI method claimed. No degree-5 rank-3, every-degree, higher-SL_m, character-algebra or ordinary IA lower-central conjecture claim.
